    How it works

    1. Open a score. Use Morning Lines or upload a single-melody MusicXML file.
    2. Pick a passage and listen. Choose a start bar and an optional end bar. Turn on your microphone and play one note at a time. Choose Scored tempo for a four-beat count-in.
    3. Play across the page break. PaperTempo previews the next page and turns when you play its first note.
    4. Review your take. Select a result to return to its bar, or choose Practise again to replay the same passage.
